summary: onepass::DFA::try_search_slots panics when callers supply more slots than the compiled regex requires, despite the API permitting any slot count. The fix caps the active explicit-slot count at the cache length and limits copying to the available cached slots. This reversal restores the original slot-count calculation, causing the fix-added test for pattern abc with four slots to slice beyond its empty explicit-slot cache. Both regions occur exactly once in their respective Git versions. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: range end index 2 out of range for slice of length 0
